headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while Hormuz and rate-repricing Stress persists
body: The Nasdaq closed 0.52% lower after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reinforced the inflation fight, while Friday's intraday downside extension later moderated before the weekly futures close. A fresh Iranian statement disputing that the Strait of Hormuz is open adds weekend gap uncertainty, but closed NQ markets provide no new failed-retracement or one-way-path evidence.
